text: 一一宝贝，你好棒，你现在比刚才有感情多了(ˊᵒ̴̶̷̤ꇴᵒ̴̶̷̤ˋ)꒰
en: 一一 Baby, you're so great; you have much more feeling now than just now (ˊᵒ̴̶̷̤ꇴᵒ̴̶̷̤ˋ)꒰

text: 尬完第二遍，第三遍，第四遍…
en: After awkwardly getting through the second, third, fourth round…

text: 一一我宝贝太棒了，唱得太棒了
en: 一一 My baby is amazing, sang so amazingly.

text: 一一我宝贝唱歌最好听
en: 一一 My baby sings best.

text: 一一宝宝，我们再来学《成全》吧
en: 一一 Baby, let's learn 'Letting Go' next.

text: 听过我唱歌的人大概能知道松龟的真实感受
en: Those who have heard me sing can probably understand Gui Song's true feelings.

text: 我先天性五音不全，别人唱歌是走调，我唱歌是没调，就跟朗读差不多吧
en: I am congenitally tone-deaf; others sing off-key, but I sing without any key at all, about the same as reading aloud.

text: 我告诉同学们我不会唱歌，好难过。
en: I told my classmates I could not sing, and felt so sad.

text: 她们总会鼓励我说，没事呀，你唱嘛，多唱唱就好了。
en: They would always encourage me, saying, it's all right, just sing, and you'll get better with more practice.

text: 等到我鼓起勇气唱的时候，她们往往就会希望我闭嘴了
en: But when I plucked up the courage to sing, they would generally wish I would shut up.

text: 所以，松龟一遍又一遍有耐心地教我唱歌，我真的好感动呀(ˊᵒ̴̶̷̤ꇴᵒ̴̶̷̤ˋ)꒰
en: So Gui Song patiently taught me to sing over and over again, and I was truly so moved (ˊᵒ̴̶̷̤ꇴᵒ̴̶̷̤ˋ)꒰

text: 我想真爱大概就是不嫌弃吧(⸝⸝⸝ᵒ̴̶̷̥́⌑ᵒ̴̶̷̣̥̀⸝⸝⸝)
en: I think true love is probably about not despising, isn't it (⸝⸝⸝ᵒ̴̶̷̥́⌑ᵒ̴̶̷̣̥̀⸝⸝⸝)

text: 松龟也会不耐烦地帮我拍照呀，比如说:
en: Gui Song would also impatiently help me take photos, for example:

text: 一一龟龟~能帮我拍一张站在大草坪上的照片吗？
en: 一一 Guigui~ can you take a photo of me standing on the big lawn?

text: 一一可以呀
en: 一一 Sure.

text: 一一我想看看你拍成什么样了？
en: 一一 I want to see how you took it?

text: 一一你过来吧
en: 一一 Come over here.

text: 冲到松龟面前的时候拌了一跤，脚踝扭伤，痛哭了(´•̥ ̯ •̥`)
en: When I rushed up to Gui Song I tripped, twisted my ankle, and cried out in pain (´•̥ ̯ •̥`)

text: 松龟着急地过来问怎么啦？
en: Gui Song hurried over and asked what was wrong?

text: 摸摸我的脚踝
en: He felt my ankle.

text: 我气鼓鼓地把他推开，一边大吼“都是因为你，你拍照这么丑，所以才害我摔跤”，一边大颗大颗地掉着眼泪
en: I pushed him away in a huff, roaring "It's all because of you; your photo was so ugly that you made me fall," while big tears streamed down my face.

text: 松龟连忙说对不起，都是他害我摔跤。
en: Gui Song quickly said sorry, that it was he who caused me to fall.

text: 看着我哭，他的眼泪也开始在眼眶里转
en: Watching me cry, his tears too began to well up in his eyes.

text: 松龟就是这样啦，每次看着我哭的时候他的眼泪就会在眼眶里打转了(⸝⸝⸝ᵒ̴̶̷̥́⌑ᵒ̴̶̷̣̥̀⸝⸝⸝)
en: Gui Song is just like this; every time he watches me cry, his tears well up in his eyes (⸝⸝⸝ᵒ̴̶̷̥́⌑ᵒ̴̶̷̣̥̀⸝⸝⸝)

text: 刚和松龟谈恋爱的时候，我还处在精神异常低迷的状态。
en: When I had just started dating Gui Song, I was still in a state of abnormally low spirits.

text: 那个时候总是情绪崩溃，止不住哭。
en: Back then I was always emotionally breaking down, unable to stop crying.

text: 从小健康快乐长大的乐观龟第一次遇见这种情况还真是手足无措呢。
en: Optimistic Turtle, who grew up healthy and happy since childhood, was really at a loss the first time he encountered such a situation.

text: 他总是伴在我旁边，眼泪汪汪地看着我，不知所措，眼神里满是慌乱，愧疚和疼惜。
en: He always stayed by my side, looking at me with tears in his eyes, at a loss, his gaze full of panic, guilt and tenderness.

text: 这大概就是一个男生最真实的样子吧。
en: This is probably a boy's most genuine state.

text: 表面上总是对一切都不屑一顾，在外人面前总把自己伪装得很爷们儿，很刚。
en: On the surface he always disdains everything, and in front of others always disguises himself as very manly and tough.

text: 其实，心明明是很柔软的啊，明明也会哭，也会爱，也会发嗲和卖萌呀。
en: In fact, his heart is clearly very soft; clearly he too can cry, can love, and can act spoiled and cute.

text: 谁说他们是直男啊，明明谈了恋爱以后就会成为暖男的呀。
en: Who says they are straight men? Clearly once they are in a relationship they become warm men.
